items.title: Ernie Cagnolatti Interview, 1961-04-05
items.q: a friend of mine, a young white trumpet player, Jerry Blumberg

ctx.x: Well, yeah, let you take good care of your teeth, you see. And one thing he knows is, you know, if they're not projecting out in a way like that, that kind of, you know, way hurts you. If you're in a way that projecting teeth, they couldn't make no good trumpet players.

I guess most trumpet players think of their teeth as a friend of mine, a young white trumpet player, Jerry Blumberg, staying here in town for about a week. I offered him some candy on Easter, some Easter eggs. He said, no, he's a trumpet player. He won't eat any candy. He thinks about his teeth. He's crazy. Yeah. Played to eat candy.
It's a good thing to think about it, right?
